name: Longbough Longbow
description: The canonical elven longbow — shaped over years or decades from Longbough wood offered by a naturally fallen limb or through druidic sign, rather than cut from living timber.
narrative_effects: Supports precise long-range archery with the restraint and reverence elven bowyery demands.
Longbough material carries a faint ambient-field responsiveness that practiced archers can feel in the draw.
